Remark
1. Remark 3.6\group ch03-weak-solutions-part-i Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0061 Functions satisfying the hypothesis of Theorem 1 have bounded mean oscillation. The inclusion $L^\infty \subset \BMO $ is proper: on $(0,1)$, $u(x)=\log x$ belongs to $\BMO $ but not to $L^\infty $.

A dyadic subcube of the unit cube $Q_0$ is obtained by repeated subdivision into $2^n$ congruent cubes; its predecessor is the cube from the preceding generation that contains it.
